summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), passing a single two-item code; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title) once; CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions; all changes were verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
